description: Owner+authority dual-signed authorization for aratame to perform READ-ONLY static-source vulnerability inspection of a specific GitHub repository at a pinned ref. Parallel to akuma's scope contract (ADR-2605151400) and tsukuroi's remediationMandate (ADR-2605291500). readOnly + writeAuthorityHeld are structural consts enforcing the READ-ONLY/STATIC-ONLY ceiling (G3). scanTools is a closed OSS allowlist (G5). For private repos, accessCredentialRef references (never stores) an owner-issued least-privilege read-only expiring credential in vault (G6 / ADR-2605231525). R0 = schema skeleton; R1 = additionalProperties=false + required-field + signature-verification gate.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of mandate creation.

repoUrl.description: Git remote URL of the repository to inspect.

ref.description: Branch / tag / commit SHA pinned for this inspection (immutable target).

publicRepo.description: If true, no credential is needed (public source); accessCredentialRef MUST be absent.

accessCredentialRef.description: G6: for private repos, a REFERENCE (not the secret) to an owner-issued, least-privilege, READ-ONLY, expiring access token stored as ciphertext in vault.etzhayyim.com. aratame never holds a platform-held credential (ADR-2605231525).

scanTools.description: G5: OSS scanners enabled for this mandate, from the closed allowlist. Commercial SAST/SCA SaaS is PROHIBITED (Charter Rider §2(e)).

allowedPaths.description: Optional path prefixes to restrict inspection to.

ownerSignature.description: Detached owner signature over the mandate payload.

authoritySignature.description: Detached authority signature over the same payload.

legalBasis.description: SOW id / bug-bounty program URL / written-authorization CID.

readOnly.description: G3: structurally true. aratame clones source read-only and runs static analyzers; never executes the target code, never writes/commits/pushes to the repo.

writeAuthorityHeld.description: G3/G13: structurally false. aratame holds no write/merge authority; remediation is tsukuroi's (propose-only).

maxReposPerWindow.description: G12: rate limit — max repos inspected per window for this mandate.
